propositions: Plan-review attestations must track whether they were signed during planning (open/idea status) or execution (in_progress+ status) phases, with execution reviews enforcing a fixed 0.80 blocking priority floor.

Compiled reducer state must maintain plan_review_phase by observing winning process_status transitions, bootstrapping from open/idea snapshots as planning and other known statuses as execution, persisting through snapshot compaction, and never updating on losing fork events.

Manifest grammar must emit review-phase and priority-floor tokens in fixed order with exact syntax, parse legacy phase-absent attestations as planning, reject malformed phase/floor combinations, and preserve existing prefix-based parser compatibility.

Phase-status compatibility must enforce planning-vs-planning/legacy acceptance, reject planning-vs-execution, accept execution-vs-planning/legacy, and conditionally accept execution-vs-execution only when priority-floor >= 0.80.

Signing transactions must collect an immutable generation before LLM/probe, retry at most three times on HEAD instability with the initial baseline, refuse to sign on stale generation or phase/material/relation changes, and write no ticket event on pre-sign failure.

Re-sign recovery must parse v2 sidecar phase/floor fields, compare result against current compiled phase, refuse incompatible/malformed combinations, and rebuild manifest from recorded review-time phase/floor rather than inferred phase.
